tools.name: browse_opportunity_category
tools.description: Open a For9a opportunity category listing page. Available categories include scholarships (منح-دراسية), competitions (جوائز-ومسابقات), fellowships (زمالات), volunteering (فرص-تطوع), workshops (ورشات-عمل-أو-دورات), exchange programs (برامج-تبادل-ثقافي-و-اقامات) and more. Optionally filter by country name in Arabic.

category.description: Category slug, e.g. منح-دراسية for scholarships or زمالات for fellowships.

country.description: Optional country name in Arabic, e.g. المملكة-العربية-السعودية.

tools.name: search_for9a
tools.description: Search For9a (for9a.com) for opportunities, jobs, courses, or articles. Navigates to the search results page for the given term.

section.description: Site section to search: opportunity (scholarships/education), jobs, courses, or learn (articles). Defaults to opportunity.
